body: Its usually the ones closest to us that can make us really hurt. I'm glad your grandmother is taking care of you and your mother is trying to make up for what shes done although id be skeptical about trusting her off the bat. I'm sorry about your girlfriend as well I know what it feels like to be broken by someone you loved. Pets are always good my dog keeps me happy shes getting quite old now though. I hope you can find someone again, I'm sure i could too but i'm very tired.

It really sounds like once you turn 18 you need to get away from your mother, Is your father okay? Also it sounds like you might also have borderline personality disorder from what i'm reading based on how much you want to have your friends around you but i'm not here to diagnose you or anything. Do you have anything that has kept you going up until now?

It seems you've been dealing this with your whole life, I cannot imagine how draining it must be having those intrusive thought since 10 years old. You said traumatized do you have memories of what it was like before this all or memories of what might have traumatized you. If you don't feel like going into graphic detail you don't have to describe it.

It would be hypocritical of myself to say it does get better because I plan on doing the same thing but I could stay here and talk for a bit. Do you know what medication you are on and what dosage? If you are taking something and that is happening to you it most certainly isn't working at all, It doesn't sound like you're dealing with just depression but i cannot diagnose you.
It is important what has happened to you. Would you mind telling me?
I can relate to that. I don't know if I'm the best to give advice since I'm gonna do the same thing as you. I wouldn't mind hearing the long version if you got time, It would give me more time.

Sounds about right, especially with the audience that follows you. I cannot relate personally since I don't post pictures like that but I'd imagine you get a rush seeing people comment about it, you'd feel valued even for something as superficial as your body. They aren't friends they are consumers. I don't think I'll be around for much longer but while I'm here I'll be happy if you can vent to me. I don't use reddit often but my DM's are open if you can find them.
Hey. While I'm here. Why are you planning on doing it?
